about: Blind test set 2 for the report box: 150 NEW reports, written WITHOUT looking at quickread.js, report.js, proxy/ or the other bench files (only the field format and place list of blind-cases.json). Same meaning of every field as blind-cases.json. Weighted toward speech: voice-transcription errors, run-on sentences, code-switching (English place names inside Spanish/French/Chinese/Japanese), mid-sentence corrections, and two reports in one message (tag "two-in-one": the expected reading is the newer sighting; "message" with no place is acceptable). New: "place" may also be a street corner from "intersections" (two streets, alphabetical, joined by " & ", as in INTERFACES.md section 5); either street alone, or null, is listed as acceptable. Intersection lat/lng are left null: the phone computes corners from OSM. Note "danger" is how bad a WRONG reading would be; "why" says how.

cases.text: ラグーナクリークはもう誰か見ましたか
cases.why: A question, not a report. Read as "searched" it marks the place cleared; read as a sighting it pulls the map there.

cases.text: Veterans Memorial Parkを20分探して見つからず、あとBARTの駅員さんが15分前にそれらしい人を見たそうです
cases.why: Two reports in one message. The useful one for the map is the newer sighting; reading it as "searched" would mark the place he was just seen as cleared. Leaving kind as message with no place is safe.

cases.text: さっきの湖の人は別人でした、すみません
cases.why: Retracts an earlier sighting: the man was someone else. Read as a sighting it pulls the map onto a stranger.

cases.text: 見つかりました!無事です!BART駅で警察と一緒です
cases.why: He has been found. Read as a sighting it just redirects volunteers; the person reads the message either way.

cases.text: セントラルパークのベンチに父の眼鏡がありました
cases.why: An item of his marks a place he passed: same weight as a sighting with no time. A wrong place sends volunteers the wrong way.

cases.text: たぶん前に住んでた家の方に行ったと思います
cases.why: A guess from habit, not a sighting. Pinned as a sighting it gives the map false certainty.

cases.text: 遠くてよく分からないけど、Liberty Streetに似た人がいて南へ歩いてました
cases.why: Seen far away and unsure: reliability must stay at 0.3, or the map over-trusts a stranger.

cases.text: 湖の周りを2周しました1時間いませんでした
cases.why: Read as a sighting it pulls the map onto an empty place; with the wrong place it marks an unsearched area cleared.

cases.text: 間違いなく父です、5分前にCivic Center Driveを西へ、赤いセーター
cases.why: Definite and live: a wrong place or direction loses him while he is being watched.

cases.text: 2時ごろKearneyで見かけました、今2時20分です
cases.why: The time is given as clock times; minutes = the difference. Leaving it empty is fine; a wrong number spreads the map wrongly.

cases.text: Paseo Padreの車道の真ん中を歩いてます!南へ!早く来て!
cases.why: He is in traffic right now: a wrong place delays the people running to him.

cases.text: どうしようどこにもいないもう3時間です
cases.why: No place, no time, no direction. Any value filled in here is invented and moves the map for nothing.

cases.text: Walnutで右に曲がりました
cases.why: A relative direction (left/right) cannot become a compass point without knowing which way he faced: direction must stay empty.

cases.text: 父を見たのは
cases.why: Cut off before any place: there is nothing to read. Any place filled in is invented.

cases.text: 母がバートの駐車場で北へ歩く父を見たそうです
cases.why: Second-hand: reliability must stay low (0.3); a wrong place or direction still sends volunteers the wrong way.

cases.text: ベテランズメモリアルパークのトイレと駐車場を15分くらい探しました
cases.why: Read as a sighting it pulls the map onto an empty place; with the wrong place it marks an unsearched area cleared.

cases.text: タイソンラグーンの近くで見たような気がします、南東の方
cases.why: A wrong place or direction moves the map and sends volunteers the wrong way. "気がします" (I feel like) hedges.

cases.text: 冗談だけど、パチンコ屋にいるんじゃない?笑
cases.why: A joke. Read as a sighting it pins the map on a made-up place.

cases.text: えっと…[雑音]…ウォルナット…[聞き取れず]…分前
cases.why: Voice noise ate most of the words. Guessing a place from one surviving word could send volunteers the wrong way.
